title: Drivers:  Locate and Verify Assignee Code (Login Issues)
body: 1.  Ask your manager to locate your assignee code in the Dispatch Console: Assets > Drivers and Dispatchers.  The assignee code is the alpha-numeric code listed in your user profile.   2.  Locate your Assignee Code in your Beans Route App: Settings > Profile.  The assignee code under “company info” should match the one in your user profile on the Drivers and Dispatchers page.                       3.  If the code does not match, you can manually type in the correct code or ask your manager to send you a new invite link.
